item.title: Why changing steel alone won’t fix soil
item.description: Cultivation decisions are often treated as a machinery choice, but their impact runs far deeper. CPM explores how one farm’s shift in soil and cropping management has changed what steel is asked to do – and why that matters for establishment. item.title: On-farm opinion: Sowing with all of the options
item.description: Adding a mounted tine model to form a fleet of four drills has extended the crop establishment choices open to one Suffolk farm, helping to match workload and conditions. CPM finds out how this stacks up and why, in only its first season, it sowed almost every hectare.
